column1: # THE MONTEVIDEO MARRIAGE-DISPENSATION REGISTER, SEARCHED FOR LERENA - 13 September 2026.
# "Arquidiocesis de Montevideo. Marriage Dispensation Records 1856-1932", in the FamilySearch
# FULL-TEXT corpus (machine-read handwriting). Searched by the register's own formulae:
#   "Lerena el impedimento"  - catches a LERENA GROOM being dispensed an impediment
#   "Lerena feligresa"       - catches a LERENA BRIDE, who is always named with her parish
# WHY: the archive's standing open question is whether MARIA LERENA, named as Pablo Armando's
# mother on his 1908 enrolment card, was a Lerena BY BIRTH - which would make her marriage to
# Juan Carlos Lerena a marriage between kin. A marriage between kin NEEDS A DISPENSATION.
# So: is there a Lerena-Lerena dispensation anywhere in Montevideo?

column1: # *** THE RESULT. ***
# 1. There is NO JUAN CARLOS LERENA anywhere in the register.
# 2. There is NO LERENA-LERENA DISPENSATION AT ALL, 1856-1932. Every Lerena in it marries OUT -
#    Fernandez, Pelaez, Alvarez, Cordero, Marquez, Autrias.
# *** WHAT THAT NARROWS, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT. ***
# It narrows one specific branch of the open question: IF Maria was a Lerena by birth AND they
# married in the archdiocese of Montevideo, there would be a dispensation. There is none. So
# either she was not a Lerena by birth - the card giving her married name, which some clerks did -
# or the marriage happened somewhere other than Montevideo.
# IT DOES NOT SHOW THEY DID NOT MARRY IN MONTEVIDEO. This register catches only two things: kin
# dispensations, and dispensations of the conciliar proclamas. A marriage between unrelated people
# with all three proclamas duly read needs no dispensation and leaves NO TRACE here at all.
# ---- 13 September 2026, later: the page-by-page turn, and where it stopped ----
# The standing job was to TURN this register page by page rather than trust full-text search, on the
# reasonable worry that machine handwriting recognition misses acts. That was not done, and the
# reason is worth stating rather than leaving the job looking untouched:
# *** THE FILM COULD NOT BE LOCATED, because FamilySearch's search endpoints went down. ***
# Catalogue search, records search and full-text search all returned "Something Went Wrong" on
# repeated attempts, from a signed-in session, while image tiles continued to serve normally. So
# this is their outage, not a block and not a permissions problem. Three separate routes to the
# film's DGS were tried - catalogue text search, catalogue place+subject search, and working back
# from a known dispensation's own image via full text - and all three failed the same way.
# The method for doing it IS now known and proved, which is the one thing that was missing before:
# navigate /search/film/<DGS>?i=<N>, read the ark from the page title, assemble the tiles. What is
# missing is only the DGS.
# *** WHAT WAS FOUND INSTEAD, by laying this file beside one gathered hours later. ***
# Three of the eight dispensations here marry a LERENA to a PELAEZ, all at Trinidad or Mercedes,
# and all requiring dispensation FOR CONSANGUINITY. The Trinidad baptisms read the same day give
# Bernabe LERENA married to Casimira PELAEZ, with four children between 1871 and 1885. Neither file
# says so on its own. Recorded in data/lerena-pelaez-trinidad.tsv.
# ============ A NINTH DISPENSATION, AND WHY THIS FILE'S SEARCH MISSED IT ============
# Found 14 September 2026.
#   Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, Marriage Dispensation Records, JUNE 1913 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-P72J-V:
#   "Senor Provisor, JOSE PEDRO MASSERA ... digo: que debiendo contraer matrimonio con Dona EMA SIXTA
#    LERENA JUANICO, FELIGRESA DE LA METROPOLITANA, para lo cual se han llenado ya todos los tramites
#    del caso; y teniendo ya de antemano designado el dia en que debe celebrarse el acto, ocurro a
#    V.S. suplicando quiera dispensarme UNA CONCILIAR PROCLAMA ... Montevideo, Junio 19 de 1913."
# *** THIS IS OUR OWN EMA SIXTA *** - sixth child of Luis Eugenio Lerena Lenguas and Julia Juanico -
# marrying the philosopher Jose Pedro Massera eleven days later, 30 June 1913. The dispensation is of
# ONE of the three banns, on grounds of the date already being fixed. No consanguinity.
# *** WHY THE SEARCH AT THE TOP OF THIS FILE MISSED HER, and it is not bad luck. ***
# The two formulae used were "Lerena el impedimento" and "LERENA FELIGRESA" - the second built on the
# assumption that a Lerena bride is named with her parish immediately after her surname.
# She is written *** "Dona Ema Sixta LERENA JUANICO, feligresa de la metropolitana" ***.
# The compound surname sits between "Lerena" and "feligresa", and the phrase search cannot see her.
# *** SO THE COUNT OF EIGHT IS WRONG, AND WORSE, THE SEARCH WAS SYSTEMATICALLY BLIND TO EXACTLY THE
# PEOPLE THIS ARCHIVE CARES MOST ABOUT. *** Every child of Luis Eugenio and Julia carries the compound
# LERENA JUANICO. Every child of Luis Lerena and Justiniana carries LERENA LENGUAS. A formula keyed to
# "Lerena" + next word could never have found any of them.
# *** WHAT THAT DOES TO THIS FILE'S CONCLUSION. *** The headline finding - "NO LERENA-LERENA
# DISPENSATION AT ALL, 1856-1932; every Lerena in it marries OUT" - is NOT withdrawn, but it is no
# longer safe on the evidence offered for it. It rests on a search that demonstrably misses compound
# surnames. *** IT NEEDS RE-RUNNING on "Lerena Juanico", "Lerena Lenguas", "Lerena Salvanach" and the
# bare surname with the place-facet rather than a following word. ***
# This is the third time in two days that the compound surname has been the thing that hid a record:
# the SERENA misindexing, the "Geraldo Dios" ghost made out of a military rank, and now this.
# ============ AND A TENTH, FOUND THE SAME DAY - MISSED TWO WAYS AT ONCE ============
#   Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, *** 3 FEBRUARY 1892 *** - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K:
#   "dispensados por el Ilustrisimo y Rmo Senor Obispo Diocesano Monsenor Doctor Don MARIANO SOLER
#    del impedimento canonico de parentesco de TERCER GRADO DE CONSANGUINIDAD CON ATINGENCIA AL
#    SEGUNDO ... Don ALFREDO GERENA ... hijo legitimo de Don AVELINO LORENA y Dona AMBROSIA TRAIBEL,
#    con Dona HERMENEGILDA CAROLINA GAVARRO"
# *** THIS SWEEP MISSED IT TWO WAYS AT ONCE, and both are the same underlying fault. ***
#   1. The groom is written GERENA. A search on LERENA cannot reach him. That is now the SEVENTH
#      spelling this family carries - Lerena, Llerena, Lorena, Serena, Lerina, Sancio, Gerena - and
#      his own father is written LORENA in the very same sentence.
#   2. The dispensation clause comes BEFORE the names, so the formula "Lerena el impedimento",
#      which assumes the surname precedes the word, cannot match.
# *** SO IN ONE DAY THIS FILE'S COUNT OF EIGHT HAS BEEN BREACHED TWICE - by Ema Sixta's compound
# surname and by Alfredo's misspelling - and it is certainly low. ***
# WHAT SURVIVES, NARROWER AND STILL WORTH SOMETHING: no LERENA-LERENA dispensation has been found.
# Alfredo married a GAVARRO. But the family DID marry kin, at the third degree touching the second,
# and the dispensation was granted personally by the first Archbishop of Montevideo.
